name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The two sentences are independent commands with no order word linking them, so Existence(door_open) and Existence(target_picked_up), both hard, match the task. The environment's constraints already force the key and the door before the box, so no extra clauses are needed.

texts: Open the door: the locked door must be open at some point during the episode.
Pick up the box in the other room: the agent must end up carrying the mission's target box.
machine:
